extraFields.label: Drinking water (galon refills)
extraFields.help: Bottled drinking water — 19-litre galon refills from a depot or a brand like Aqua — as a monthly amount. Tap (PDAM) water goes in the water and gas box.

single.note: Estimate: 4–8 galons a month at Rp7,000 (depot refill) to Rp25,000 (branded).

extraFields.label: Neighbourhood or building fees (IPL, iuran RT/RW)
extraFields.help: Monthly fees for your neighbourhood or building: iuran RT/RW, security, rubbish collection, or the apartment service charge (IPL) if it is not included in your rent.

single.note: Estimate; kos rooms usually include these.

youngpro.note: Estimate: apartment IPL is often Rp15,000–25,000 per m² a month if not in the rent.

extraFields.label: Arisan contribution
extraFields.help: Your monthly payment into an arisan — a rotating savings group where every member pays in and one member wins the whole pot each round. It works like saving rather than spending, so it is not an essential bill, but count it here so you know where the money goes.

localTips.title: Check your PLN power level and token habits
localTips.why: All households from 1,300 VA up pay the same Rp1,444.70 per kWh, so savings come from using fewer kWh, mainly AC and water heaters.
tips: Set the AC to 25–26°C with a timer and close doors to the room you are cooling.
Buy prepaid tokens in larger amounts: the admin fee is per purchase.
Swap old fluorescent tubes and incandescent bulbs for LED.

localTips.title: Mix KRL, TransJakarta and MRT instead of daily ojek
localTips.why: TransJakarta costs Rp3,500 a trip and KRL fares start from a few thousand rupiah, far below ride-hailing for the same distance.
tips: Use ojek only for the first and last kilometre to the station.
Use one card (e.g. JakLingko-linked) so transfers are integrated and cheaper.
Compare a week of ride-hailing receipts with the public transport cost of the same trips.

localTips.title: Switch branded galons for a trusted refill depot
localTips.why: Refilling at a licensed depot costs a fraction of branded galons.
tips: Choose a depot that shows a current health/hygiene certificate.
Or boil and filter PDAM water for cooking.
Buy galons in a monthly delivery plan if your depot offers one.
